title: Rabbi Chiyya bar Ze’ira
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Bamidbar Rabbah 11:2, expounding “and you shall be a blessing” — your blessing precedes his blessing, for they first say “Shield of Abraham” and afterward “Who revives the dead.” Hyman calls this a scribal error and proposes as in Bereshit Rabbah 39:11: “Rabbi Achavah in the name of Rabbi (it should read: bar) Ze’ira,” identifying him as Ahavah son of Rabbi Zeira.

notes.text: The connected tail of the saved Bereshit Rabbah 39 witness has Rabbi Achavya in Rabbi Zeira’s name and the “yours before Mine” teaching. The supplied Achavah spelling and Hyman’s proposed relationship/emendation remain distinct; the whole long chapter was not claimed read.
